title: Debt beside low-yield cash
hook: Two stated cases: explore the interest-rate spread on both balance-sheet sides.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the interest-rate spread on both balance-sheet sides affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Drag, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the interest-rate spread on both balance-sheet sides in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Toy debt 1000 costs interest 0.2; cash 1000 earns yield 0.02 over the same period. What is interest cost minus cash income?
